issue: np.clip should propagate NaN inputs instead of silently clamping them to the interval bounds; implement it via the ufunc pair that preserves NaN.

    return np.fmin(np.fmax(a, a_min), a_max)

    return np.sort(np.stack([np.broadcast_to(a_min, a.shape), a, np.broadcast_to(a_max, a.shape)]), axis=0)[1]
